# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 41 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 38 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_041_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 41

**1** Jesus said: "Whoever has something in hand will be given more, and whoever has nothing — even what little he has will be taken from him."

---

**Translation Notes (LOGOS):**
- "Has something in hand" — active possession; having and holding
- The reversal: the possessor gains; the non-possessor loses even the minimum
- In Thomas's context: the possession is gnosis; those who have knowledge gain more; those without lose even their potential

---
